shared_elements: upright stone slab with rounded/domed top
incised low-relief carving on a single flat face
weathered pale-to-grey stone surface in a museum display setting
justification: Both are upright stone slabs with a rounded top bearing shallow incised decoration divided into stacked zones by horizontal lines, and both include a discrete circular/disc element among the carved motifs, which gives a broadly similar silhouette and surface treatment. But A's carving is a fine, dense, legible scene of seated and kneeling human figures with offering furniture and sign-like glyphs in narrative registers, whereas B's is a coarse, sparse, highly schematic arrangement of arcs, spirals and a central disc on a massive block with no figural scene at all.}
